hypothesis: The constant (equiangular) spiral angle of gastropod shells is seldom below 80 degrees and usually 80-85 degrees.
pass_criterion: At least 70% of shells have a spiral angle in 80-85 degrees and fewer than 10% are below 80 degrees.
fail_criterion: Fewer than 40% of shells fall in 80-85 degrees, or more than 25% are below 80 degrees.
interpretation: Angle is derived from expansion rate W as alpha = arctan(2*pi/ln W). The dataset has gastropods only, so the Nautilus (about 80 degrees) and ammonoid parts are untested.
